standard_locator: SysML v2 specification, KerML/SysML textual notation: view definition, view usage and expose relationship
review_steps: Parse and analyse the exact model bytes with the fixed tool version.
Locate the view definition and typed view usage in the parser-backed source.
Confirm the expose statement selects B0-MODEL-SYSTEM and not an unrelated element.
Bind this review to the SHA-256 of the reviewed model bytes.
limitations: This records a version-bound manual semantic check for D2 review; it is not PA approval, D2 approval, implementation evidence, or a SysML tool-conformance claim.
